instruction: Add the .xcf file from the Desktop to a LibreOffice Writer file, then save it on the Desktop as 'graphic.docx'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires embedding the .xcf image into LibreOffice Writer and saving as graphic.docx. The evaluator checks if the DOCX file contains at least one embedded image with width >= 1000 pixels. Custom getter extracts images from the DOCX file and verifies their dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: All instruction requirements are verified (file existence, image embedded, image dimensions)
Getter logic correct: Properly extracts DOCX from VM, parses document relationships to find embedded images, uses PIL to get dimensions
Metric logic correct: Appropriate scoring with file existence (40%), image presence (30%), and width validation (30%)
Expected values semantically correct: has_image=true matches instruction, min_width=1000 is reasonable threshold for the 1200px-wide xcf file
Postconfig appropriate: Activates window and saves document to ensure getter can read final state
Data flow correct: Getter extracts {file_exists, image_count, max_width}, metric compares against {has_image, min_width}, all types align
Runtime feasible: Uses standard libraries (python-docx, PIL) and OSWorld APIs, includes error handling
State accessibility: File is saved to disk by postconfig before getter reads it, no timing issues expected
